mainEntity.name: What is the benefit of working with a design-build firm instead of hiring an architect and contractor separately?

acceptedAnswer.text: A design-build approach eliminates the traditional owner-architect-contractor gaps by combining design and construction teams. This reduces coordination issues, helps control costs, and ensures the design is buildable and aligned with your goals from day one. lineworkdevelopment+1
